title: The gap between two runs of the logistic map at r = 4 (log scale)
description: Bar chart on a logarithmic scale of the difference between two runs of x → 4x(1 − x), started at 0.3 and 0.300001 (computed for kloom): 0.000001 at the start, 0.00002 after 5 steps, 0.00045 after 10, 0.026 after 15 and 0.91 after 20, when the two runs have nothing in common.
heading: GAP BETWEEN TWO RUNS · r = 4 · LOG SCALE
